sourceTitle: Pollo AI turns creative ideas into campaigns with OpenAI
originalTitle: Pollo AI turns creative ideas into campaigns with OpenAI
author: OpenAI

blocks.text: Pollo AI was founded on the premise that people should be able to turn their creative ideas into finished images and videos without needing production expertise. Even with generative AI, creators and marketers can struggle to navigate different tools and choose between models to get the result they want. Some may even abandon their projects in frustration.
blocks.en: Pollo AI was founded on the premise that people should be able to turn their creative ideas into finished images and videos without needing production expertise. Even with generative AI, creators and marketers can struggle to navigate different tools and choose between models to get the result they want. Some may even abandon their projects in frustration.
blocks.zh: Pollo AI 创立时秉持的理念是：即使没有专业制作知识，人们也应该能够将创意变成完整的图片和视频作品。即便有了生成式 AI，创作者和营销人员仍可能难以驾驭各种工具，也不知该选择哪种模型才能获得理想效果。有些人甚至可能因挫败感而放弃项目。

blocks.text: “We want to do for video what Canva did for design. We want to make it easy enough that more people can actually use it, not just the ones who already know how,” explains Bill Zhu, the founder and CEO of Pollo AI. Today, Pollo AI serves more than 26 million users who use the platform to create videos, ads, and visual content.
blocks.en: “We want to do for video what Canva did for design. We want to make it easy enough that more people can actually use it, not just the ones who already know how,” explains Bill Zhu, the founder and CEO of Pollo AI. Today, Pollo AI serves more than 26 million users who use the platform to create videos, ads, and visual content.
blocks.zh: “我们希望像 Canva 改变设计那样，改变视频创作。我们想把它变得足够简单，让更多人真正用起来，而不只是那些本来就会的人。”Pollo AI 创始人兼首席执行官 Bill Zhu 解释道。如今，Pollo AI 已服务超过 2,600 万用户，他们使用该平台制作视频、广告和视觉内容。

blocks.text: “As OpenAI’s models have improved, more of the workflows Pollo wanted to support have become practical inside the product. That means users can start from simpler inputs, spend less time figuring out the process, and get to stronger outputs more reliably.”
blocks.en: “As OpenAI’s models have improved, more of the workflows Pollo wanted to support have become practical inside the product. That means users can start from simpler inputs, spend less time figuring out the process, and get to stronger outputs more reliably.”
blocks.zh: “随着 OpenAI 模型不断改进，Pollo 希望支持的更多工作流程已能在产品中落地。这意味着用户只需提供更简单的输入，花更少的时间摸索流程，就能更稳定地获得更好的结果。”

blocks.text: The team’s first breakthrough was video templates. Now, 30% of creator sessions start from these templates or trending-format workflows. Building on this success, the company’s latest offering is Pollo Agent. It uses OpenAI models, including GPT‑6 Astra and GPT‑Image‑2.5, to provide a fully guided workflow for video creation, including this post-apocalyptic adventure from a Pollo AI user.
blocks.en: The team’s first breakthrough was video templates. Now, 30% of creator sessions start from these templates or trending-format workflows. Building on this success, the company’s latest offering is Pollo Agent. It uses OpenAI models, including GPT‑6 Astra and GPT‑Image‑2.5, to provide a fully guided workflow for video creation, including this post-apocalyptic adventure from a Pollo AI user.
blocks.zh: 团队的第一个突破是视频模板。如今，创作者有 30% 的创作会话是从这些模板或热门内容形式的工作流程开始的。在这一成功的基础上，公司推出了最新产品 Pollo Agent。它使用 GPT‑6 Astra 和 GPT‑Image‑2.5 等 OpenAI 模型，为视频创作提供全程引导。这支由 Pollo AI 用户制作的末日后冒险视频便是其中一例。

blocks.text: Turning the user’s creative intent into finished content
blocks.en: Turning the user’s creative intent into finished content
blocks.zh: 将用户的创作意图转化为完整作品

blocks.text: Pollo Agent interprets the user’s rough ideas and visual references, and then develops storylines, scene flows, and scripts. CTO Peter Zhou says OpenAI models stood out for their ability to understand ambiguous creative inputs and their multimodal capability, sharing: “GPT‑5.6 performed especially well there.” The team also said they value the OpenAI API’s stability and release cadence.
blocks.en: Pollo Agent interprets the user’s rough ideas and visual references, and then develops storylines, scene flows, and scripts. CTO Peter Zhou says OpenAI models stood out for their ability to understand ambiguous creative inputs and their multimodal capability, sharing: “GPT‑5.6 performed especially well there.” The team also said they value the OpenAI API’s stability and release cadence.
blocks.zh: Pollo Agent 会理解用户的初步想法和视觉参考素材，进而构思故事情节、场景衔接和脚本。首席技术官 Peter Zhou 表示，OpenAI 模型凭借对模糊创意输入的理解能力和多模态能力脱颖而出。他分享道：“GPT‑5.6 在这方面表现尤为出色。”团队还表示，他们也看重 OpenAI API 的稳定性和版本发布节奏。

blocks.text: To balance reasoning depth, speed, and cost, Pollo AI uses GPT‑5.6 for routing and GPT‑6 Astra for more challenging work, such as developing a narrative or planning scene revisions. This model mix lets the system match the level of reasoning to the task based on the user’s prompt. Pollo AI reports that users spend more than 50% less time choosing or switching models, giving them more time for creativity.
blocks.en: To balance reasoning depth, speed, and cost, Pollo AI uses GPT‑5.6 for routing and GPT‑6 Astra for more challenging work, such as developing a narrative or planning scene revisions. This model mix lets the system match the level of reasoning to the task based on the user’s prompt. Pollo AI reports that users spend more than 50% less time choosing or switching models, giving them more time for creativity.
blocks.zh: 为平衡推理深度、速度和成本，Pollo AI 使用 GPT‑5.6 进行任务路由，将构思故事或规划场景修改等更具挑战性的工作交给 GPT‑6 Astra。通过这种模型组合，系统可以根据用户的提示词，为任务匹配相应的推理深度。据 Pollo AI 介绍，用户选择或切换模型所花的时间减少了 50% 以上，因此能把更多时间用于创作。

blocks.text: Pollo AI tests generative models against real user prompts and workflows, evaluating output quality, consistency, stylistic range, speed, and cost. GPT‑Image‑2.5 was selected to handle image generation, helping creators make posters, storyboards, and campaign visuals.
blocks.en: Pollo AI tests generative models against real user prompts and workflows, evaluating output quality, consistency, stylistic range, speed, and cost. GPT‑Image‑2.5 was selected to handle image generation, helping creators make posters, storyboards, and campaign visuals.
blocks.zh: Pollo AI 使用真实用户的提示词和工作流程来测试生成式模型，评估输出质量、一致性、风格多样性、速度和成本。团队选用 GPT‑Image‑2.5 负责图像生成，帮助创作者制作海报、分镜和广告视觉素材。

blocks.text: “If we receive any task from a user to generate an image, we always use GPT-Image-2.5. It’s especially good at working with different types of characters and letters.”
blocks.en: “If we receive any task from a user to generate an image, we always use GPT-Image-2.5. It’s especially good at working with different types of characters and letters.”
blocks.zh: “只要收到用户的图像生成任务，我们都会使用 GPT-Image-2.5。它尤其擅长处理不同类型的字符和字母。”

blocks.text: Converting product photos into videos
blocks.en: Converting product photos into videos
blocks.zh: 将产品照片转化为视频

blocks.text: Pollo AI’s primary users are content creators, and the platform is especially popular for creating micro dramas with both AI and human actors. However, more marketers and business owners are starting to use Pollo AI to develop video content quickly and easily too.
blocks.en: Pollo AI’s primary users are content creators, and the platform is especially popular for creating micro dramas with both AI and human actors. However, more marketers and business owners are starting to use Pollo AI to develop video content quickly and easily too.
blocks.zh: Pollo AI 的主要用户是内容创作者，该平台尤其受短剧创作者欢迎，他们用它制作由 AI 角色和真人演员出演的短剧。与此同时，越来越多营销人员和企业主也开始使用 Pollo AI，轻松快捷地制作视频内容。

blocks.text: Pollo’s Photo to Video Ads tool in its Marketing Studio suite uses OpenAI models to turn a still image and prompt into a short video. It’s designed to help small businesses and DTC brands generate product ads for social media in minutes rather than days.
blocks.en: Pollo’s Photo to Video Ads tool in its Marketing Studio suite uses OpenAI models to turn a still image and prompt into a short video. It’s designed to help small businesses and DTC brands generate product ads for social media in minutes rather than days.
blocks.zh: Pollo 营销工作室套件中的照片转视频广告工具，使用 OpenAI 模型将静态图片和提示词转化为短视频。这款工具旨在帮助小型企业和直接面向消费者的品牌，在几分钟内生成用于社交媒体的产品广告，而不必耗时数天。

blocks.text: One Pollo AI user wanted to use a product photo to make a fragrance ad that felt luxurious. The static photo alone could not convey that mood, and a professional video shoot was beyond their budget.
blocks.en: One Pollo AI user wanted to use a product photo to make a fragrance ad that felt luxurious. The static photo alone could not convey that mood, and a professional video shoot was beyond their budget.
blocks.zh: 一位 Pollo AI 用户想用一张产品照片制作一支富有奢华感的香水广告。单靠静态照片无法传达这种氛围，而专业视频拍摄又超出了预算。

blocks.text: Using Photo to Video Ad, the user turned their starting image into a roughly 15-second video ad. The tool generated velvet textures, warm spotlights, and close-ups of the bottle to establish the mood across the sequence and ended it with the fragrance framed against deep red fabric.
blocks.en: Using Photo to Video Ad, the user turned their starting image into a roughly 15-second video ad. The tool generated velvet textures, warm spotlights, and close-ups of the bottle to establish the mood across the sequence and ended it with the fragrance framed against deep red fabric.
blocks.zh: 借助照片转视频广告工具，这位用户将原始图片变成了一支约 15 秒的视频广告。工具生成了天鹅绒质感、暖色聚光灯和瓶身特写，在整个视频中营造出奢华氛围，最后以深红色织物映衬下的香水画面收尾。

blocks.text: Creating a luxury campaign with GPT‑Image‑2.5
blocks.en: Creating a luxury campaign with GPT‑Image‑2.5
blocks.zh: 使用 GPT‑Image‑2.5 打造高端广告

blocks.text: Another customer, a jewelry brand, wanted a bold editorial campaign image, but its budget could not stretch to a high-concept studio shoot.
blocks.en: Another customer, a jewelry brand, wanted a bold editorial campaign image, but its budget could not stretch to a high-concept studio shoot.
blocks.zh: 另一位客户是一家珠宝品牌，希望制作一张大胆前卫、具有时尚大片风格的广告图片，但预算不足以支持创意要求如此之高的棚拍。

blocks.text: Using Pollo Agent and GPT‑Image‑2.5, the brand was able to turn its creative vision of its statement jewelry on a model seated beside a cheetah into reality. The tool framed the scene with dark drapery and warm lighting and ensured that the brand’s jewelry products were highly visible.
blocks.en: Using Pollo Agent and GPT‑Image‑2.5, the brand was able to turn its creative vision of its statement jewelry on a model seated beside a cheetah into reality. The tool framed the scene with dark drapery and warm lighting and ensured that the brand’s jewelry products were highly visible.
blocks.zh: 借助 Pollo Agent 和 GPT‑Image‑2.5，该品牌实现了自己的创意构想：让一位模特佩戴设计醒目的珠宝，坐在猎豹身旁。工具以深色帷幔和暖色灯光布置场景，同时确保品牌的珠宝产品在画面中格外突出。

blocks.text: The customer got a finished luxury campaign visual with lower production effort, time, and cost compared to live shoot.
blocks.en: The customer got a finished luxury campaign visual with lower production effort, time, and cost compared to live shoot.
blocks.zh: 与实景拍摄相比，客户以更少的制作投入、时间和成本，获得了一张可直接使用的高端广告视觉图。

blocks.text: Turning product shots into magical worlds
blocks.en: Turning product shots into magical worlds
blocks.zh: 将产品照片变成奇幻世界

blocks.text: Pollo AI also makes it easy for customers to start with a product photo and leverage OpenAI models to turn it into an image that’s far more creative. For example, a beverage brand wanted its peach soda to feel playful and imaginative in an advertising campaign, but a standard studio product shot could not capture what the team had in mind.
blocks.en: Pollo AI also makes it easy for customers to start with a product photo and leverage OpenAI models to turn it into an image that’s far more creative. For example, a beverage brand wanted its peach soda to feel playful and imaginative in an advertising campaign, but a standard studio product shot could not capture what the team had in mind.
blocks.zh: Pollo AI 还让客户能够轻松地从一张产品照片出发，借助 OpenAI 模型将其变成更具创意的图片。例如，一家饮料品牌希望在广告中赋予自家桃子汽水趣味和想象力，但常规的产品棚拍无法呈现团队心中的构想。

blocks.text: Using Pollo Agent and GPT‑Image‑2.5, which brings sharper details and faster generation to creative workflows, the team transformed a simple bottle image into a snowy miniature landscape, complete with a train, lizards, and sparkling droplets. The finished image created a playful scene the brand could use in its campaign.
blocks.en: Using Pollo Agent and GPT‑Image‑2.5, which brings sharper details and faster generation to creative workflows, the team transformed a simple bottle image into a snowy miniature landscape, complete with a train, lizards, and sparkling droplets. The finished image created a playful scene the brand could use in its campaign.
blocks.zh: 团队使用 Pollo Agent 和 GPT‑Image‑2.5，将一张简单的瓶子图片变成了白雪覆盖的微缩景观，其中还有火车、蜥蜴和晶莹的水珠。GPT‑Image‑2.5 为创意工作流程带来了更清晰的细节和更快的生成速度。最终生成的图片呈现出一个趣味盎然的场景，可供品牌用于广告宣传。

blocks.text: What’s next for AI video
blocks.en: What’s next for AI video
blocks.zh: AI 视频的下一步

blocks.text: Pollo wants AI video to become part of everyday content creation over the next 12 months. For Zhu, that depends on making it even easier to turn an idea into an asset ready to post, test, or use in a campaign, something Pollo AI is enabled to deliver with the continued improvement of OpenAI models and image generation.
blocks.en: Pollo wants AI video to become part of everyday content creation over the next 12 months. For Zhu, that depends on making it even easier to turn an idea into an asset ready to post, test, or use in a campaign, something Pollo AI is enabled to deliver with the continued improvement of OpenAI models and image generation.
blocks.zh: Pollo 希望在未来 12 个月内，让 AI 视频成为日常内容创作的一部分。在 Zhu 看来，关键在于让用户更轻松地将创意转化为可直接发布、测试或用于营销活动的素材。随着 OpenAI 模型和图像生成能力持续提升，Pollo AI 正具备实现这一目标的能力。

blocks.text: “We think the AI shift in content creation will favor products that make creation more repeatable from the start, with stronger formats, less trial and error, and a simpler workflow around the models themselves,” he says.
blocks.en: “We think the AI shift in content creation will favor products that make creation more repeatable from the start, with stronger formats, less trial and error, and a simpler workflow around the models themselves,” he says.
blocks.zh: 他说：“我们认为，在 AI 推动的内容创作变革中，更有优势的产品会从一开始就让创作更易于重复实现：提供更成熟的内容形式，减少试错，并围绕模型本身简化工作流程。”
